title: HomeGuard Household Liability Credit on CondoGuard Liability Steps
content:
**Does a HomeGuard homeowners policy change the price of a CondoGuard liability raise?** Yes. On the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy, the household liability multiplier on the liability step premium is 0.80 when the customer holds an in-force HomeGuard homeowners policy whose personal liability limit is 500,000 USD or more, 0.90 when the customer holds an in-force HomeGuard homeowners policy whose personal liability limit is below 500,000 USD, and 1.00 when the customer holds no in-force HomeGuard homeowners policy. The multiplier is applied to the tier's liability step premium itself, before the full-year liability step charge is rounded. Where the liability step premium carries more than one multiplier, the multipliers are first multiplied together and then applied once to the tier's liability step premium; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Which records decide it?** The customer's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy records: whether a HomeGuard policy of the customer is in force, and the personal liability limit on that policy's declarations, compared with 500000 USD.

| Customer's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy | Its personal liability limit | Household liability multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| in force | 500000 USD or more | 0.80 |
| in force | below 500000 USD | 0.90 |
| none in force | not read | 1.00, no household adjustment |

**Worked questions (hypothetical households).**

- *An in-force HomeGuard policy with a personal liability limit of exactly 500000 USD?* 500000 USD is 500,000 USD or more, so 0.80.
- *An in-force HomeGuard policy with 300000 USD of personal liability?* Below 500000 USD, so 0.90.
- *A HomeGuard policy that has expired or been cancelled, and no other?* The customer holds no in-force HomeGuard homeowners policy, so 1.00.
- *The figure?* A tier liability step premium of 18.00 USD with 0.80 and no other multiplier on the step premium gives 18.00 multiplied by 0.80, 14.40 USD for the full-year liability step charge of one step.
